text:
maria-iam: Heads up — saw a customer report where SSO users from our partner org are getting member role instead of admin after JIT. Happening intermittently since yesterday afternoon.

sam-engineering: Do we have logs showing the SAML assertion?

maria-iam: Pasted sanitized assertion from the support ticket: ``<Attribute Name="department">Engineering/Platform/InfraOps/LongSubteamNameTruncatedHere</Attribute>`` — looks truncated at 64 chars. Role mapping rule uses department prefix to grant admin when department == "Platform/InfraOps".

jordan-secops: Could be an attribute size limit in our SAML ingest or at the proxy (we recently enabled SNI header compression on the IdP->proxy side). Any errors in assertion parsing?

sam-engineering: Found this in the assertion parser logs: ``WARN 2025-08-05T16:22:14Z parser: attr "department" truncated (len=64) -> mapping miss``

sam-engineering: Config snippet from SAML middleware: ``max_attr_length: 64`` — looks like a default we set ages ago for other attrs.

maria-iam: Ugh. That explains the JIT provisioning mapping miss. Customer had a long department string and mapping fell back to member.

jordan-secops: Impact: potential least-privilege violations (users who should be admins are stuck as members). Also audit gap: the role-change event didn't log the original assertion content because we redact long attrs. Need to fix both mapping and audit.

sam-engineering: Proposed immediate mitigation: bump max_attr_length to 256 and add a short-term fallback rule that normalizes by prefix match (startsWith "Platform/InfraOps") rather than exact equality. Will open a canary rollout to Dedicated first.

maria-iam: For audit/compliance: we need to preserve a hashed form of the full attribute in the audit trail (not plaintext). Can we HMAC the raw attribute with our KMS-managed key so security team can verify without storing plaintext?

jordan-secops: Yes — we should integrate with KMS for audit HMAC. Concern: key access pattern must be auditable and only available to the assertion-ingest service. I'll file an access policy and key rotation plan.

sam-engineering: Implementation plan: (1) patch parser to accept 1024 byte attr and don't truncate; (2) add prefix-based mapping rule; (3) compute HMAC(attr) using KMS API and store in audit_logs as hex; (4) add unit tests and an internal e2e with a long-dept assertion. Rolling deploy: canary 1% -> 10% -> 100% over 2h.

maria-iam: Security review items: ensure HMAC key never leaves KMS, ensure logs still redact PII in other attrs (email), update SOC2 artifact. I'll sync with compliance on wording.

okta-bot: Notified: Okta connector v3 shows 2 failed mappings for tenant partner-acme since 2025-08-05T15:40:12Z.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-4921 "SSO JIT role mismatch due to department truncation". Priority: P2.

sam-engineering: Quick rollback option if mapping rule causes regressions: revert mapping to exact-match and force-only-allow the new parser on a subset. Also flag all users who got downgraded and trigger a manual re-eval job that reprocesses their last assertion (using HMAC to find original).

jordan-secops: Agree. Also add an alert if >0.1% of users in a tenant have role changes in a 1h window.

maria-iam: I'll coordinate comms with the affected customer and run the compliance checklist. Great work.

sam-engineering: I'll open PR with the parser bump + tests now and link to this thread.

maria-iam: Thanks — please tag me and secops on the PR.

jordan-secops: Adding list of follow-ups: audit HMAC design doc, KMS IAM policy, rollout playbook, postmortem if we see >50 users affected.

maria-iam: Closing loop: change scheduled for canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
